method: Offline vm execution of captured public script with a minimal DOM derived from the captured HTML; no browser, no form submit, no network. Shims are diagnostic only and do not modify employer files.
diagnosis: The captured page lacks nav toggle and stats nodes. The unchanged shared script stops at the missing nav toggle before registering form submit. Adding only that node exposes a second failure at stats. With both simulated nodes present, the actual script registers the form handler.
